howto.name: Enter the data to encode
howto.text: URL, contact card (vCard), wifi credentials, plain text, or any string up to ~2,500 characters.

howto.name: Choose size and format
howto.text: Pixel dimensions of the output QR. Format: PNG (raster) or SVG (vector, scales infinitely).

howto.name: Download the QR
howto.text: PrivaTools generates a QR code with error correction level L (default; supports up to 7% damage).

faq.a: No. Codes are generated black on white; custom colours and centre logos are not supported. Plain high-contrast codes are also the most reliable to scan.

faq.q: How do I encode a URL with parameters?
faq.a: Just paste the full URL. Special characters are encoded automatically inside the QR.

faq.q: What's the maximum data I can encode?
faq.a: Around 2,500 alphanumeric characters or 4,000 numeric digits at error correction level L. Higher EC levels reduce capacity.
